204K likes, 877 comments - kikifoodies on July 13, 2026: "Episode 2 of Sunday Rice we are making Butter Chicken Rice... who’s trying this, it’s sooo good. 

Detailed written recipe on my website or comment rice and I’ll send it to your DM.

Chicken Marinade
700 g boneless, skinless chicken thighs, chicken breast, or a combination of both
3/4 teaspoon salt change to 1 teaspoon 
½ teaspoon ground cumin
1 teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon garam masala
1 teaspoon curry powder
½ teaspoon cayenne pepper, adjust to taste
½ cup plain yogurt (110 g)
1 tablespoon lemon juice, about ½ a lemon

For the Rice

2 tablespoons butter (28 g)
1 medium onion, finely diced (150 g)
4 cloves garlic, minced (20 g)
1 tablespoon grated ginger (15 g)
2 tablespoons tomato paste (65 g)
2 cups tomato puree or passata (480 g)
1 teaspoon paprika
1 teaspoon cayenne pepper, adjust to taste
1 teaspoon curry powder
1 teaspoon ground cumin
1 teaspoon garam masala
1 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder, or 1 cube, crumbled
2 ½ teaspoons salt
1 teaspoon sugar
1 cup chicken stock (240 ml)
1½ cups water (360 ml), add up to 2 cups if needed depending on your rice
1 cup heavy cream or double cream (240 ml)
4 cups washed long grain sella basmati rice (780g)

Garnish
Chopped cilantro or parsley
#Sundayrice #Butterchicken #jollofrice 
https://kikifoodies.com/recipes/butter-chicken-rice/".

audio.transcript: For episode two of Sunday rice, we're making butter chicken rice. For this recipe, I'm using chicken breast and chicken thighs. I'll marinate the chicken with some plain unsweetened yogurt, curry powder, salt, garlic powder, ginger powder, cayenne pepper, cumin, garam masala, and lemon juice. Mix everything really well, then cover and let it marinate in the fridge for a couple of minutes. Now, I'll heat up a large pot. This is a one-pot dish, so everything is going to cook in the same pot. I'll add the chicken and sear until the chicken is nicely browned and fully cooked. When it's ready, take the chicken out, add butter to the pan. Add some chopped onions, minced garlic and ginger, then cook for about one to two minutes until the onions are softened. Add tomato paste, cook for a couple of minutes until it darkens slightly. Keep stirring so it doesn't burn. Now it's time to add the tomato puree. Give it a good mix, then season with some paprika, cayenne pepper, curry powder, cumin, chicken bouillon cubes, garam masala, salt, and a little sugar. The sugar just helps balance the acidity of the tomatoes. It doesn't make the rice taste sweet. I've added some chicken stock and water. Now, I'll just let this simmer for about 15 minutes. After about 15 minutes, I'll add heavy cream, then give it a very good mix until it's smooth and creamy. Next, I'll add the rice. I already rinsed the rice several times until the water ran clear. And I'm using long grain basmati rice for this recipe. I'll mix everything together, then cover and allow to cook on low heat for about 30 minutes until the rice is fully cooked. Once the rice is cooked, I'll stir it very well to allow some of the steam escape. Finally, I'll add the chicken back in. Give everything one final mix, then finish with some chopped cilantro or parsley for some freshness and color. And just like that, the butter chicken rice is ready.
